title: 20 overstaying Chinese in Davao Region flown to Manila

blocks.text: DAVAO CITY — The 20 Chinese nationals arrested in the Davao Region for alleged illegal mining and immigration violations were airlifted to Manila Tuesday morning aboard a Philippine Air Force C295 plane. Col. Rosa Ma. Cristina Rosete-Manuel, the new head of the Public Information Office of the Army’s Eastern Mindanao Command (EastMinCom), told reporters the Chinese nationals will be brought straight to Camp Bagong Diwa in Taguig City upon arrival in the capital.
